name: jira-workbench
description: Local Jira and SVN service with an official Codex Plugin, MCP Apps workbench, App Server integration, and a minimal Windows desktop UI host.

scripts.test: node --test "packages/core/test/*.test.mjs" "packages/codex/test/*.test.mjs" "packages/dsh/test/*.test.mjs" && npm run test:dsh-client && npm run test:codex-client
scripts.test:dsh-client: npm --workspace @jira-workbench/dsh-client run typecheck && npm --workspace @jira-workbench/dsh-client run build && node --test "packages/dsh-client/test/*.test.mjs"
